meanings.note: Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'пустить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'let go', paired with 'отпускать'.

examples.text: Сегодня он ей подарок сделает, завтра она его в бар отпустит.
examples.trans: Today he will give her a gift, tomorrow she will let him go to the bar.

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('material, tangible').

examples.text: Шеф говорит, что это очень материальный выбор.

meanings.note: Prefix 'при-' indicates approaching, attachment, or slight degree of action (stem 'знаться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to admit, confess', paired with 'признаваться'.

examples.text: Если признаться себе в том, чего по-настоящему хочешь.
examples.trans: If you admit to yourself what you truly want.
Well, did he confess?

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'to oneself', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Если признаться себе в том, чего по-настоящему хочешь.

examples.trans: Listen, can you turn off that annoying sound?

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem '-настоящему').

examples.text: Если признаться себе в том, чего по-настоящему хочешь.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'want', paired with 'захотеть'.

examples.text: Понимаю, гормоны шалят. Я просто захотела тушёнки!

examples.text: Шеф, мы вас ждём. Мы просто хотели, чтобы вы нам помогли.

meanings.note: Prefix 'во-' ('into, up') marks inward or upward movement (stem 'зможно'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.trans: Perhaps a miracle will happen.

examples.text: Как это сегодня вечером? Это невозможно!

examples.trans: The evening was wonderful.

meanings.note: Prefix 'про-' indicates movement through, completion, or missing the mark (stem 'изойти'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to happen', paired with 'происходить'.

выходить.gloss: to go out, to get out

meanings.en: to go out, to come out
meanings.note: Prefix 'вы-' ('out of') marks outward movement or thorough completion (stem 'ходить'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to go out, to get out', paired with 'выйти'.

examples.trans: Marry me!

examples.text: Ты мне даёшь пятьсот рублей, а я выхожу и покупаю тебе лучшую приставку в мире.
